comments.content: `get_doc_ids_by_doc_names` returns `None` when no documents match, but the caller in `api_app.py` immediately does `doc_ids.append(...)`, which will raise `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'append'`. Return an empty list instead of `None`.
`DocumentService.get_doc_ids_by_doc_names` can return `None` when no names match, causing `doc_ids.append(...)` to fail. Ensure the service returns `[]` or guard with `or []` here.

The query filters only by `name`, not by `tenant_id`/`kb_id`. Since document names are not globally unique, this can return document IDs belonging to other tenants/knowledge bases, allowing deletion of unrelated documents. Filter by the current tenant/kb as well.
